items.title: Manuel Paul Interview, 1960-04-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know, uh, Brown? Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] Mm-hmm.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Now here's this fellow. You know Landry? Oh, yes. I remember him.
Mm-hmm. Suzaphone. You know this fellow here? That's, uh, the old man there. Used to play in the WPA man. He died. And, uh, Suzaphone? Let me... Yeah, I can't think of his name. Um... He died.
